title: Hudson Soft: New Soft Line Up for Sega Saturn
native_title: ハドソン新作プレビュー
overview:
Hudson Soft: New Soft Line Up for Sega Saturn is a preview disc from Hudson Soft showcasing five of its upcoming Saturn releases.

- Virus
- Willy Wombat
- Bulk Slash
- Koden Kourei Jutsu: Hyaku Monogatari
- Momotarou Douchuuki
